description:
Get recent large/whale trades above threshold value on the Stacks ecosystem. Useful for tracking smart money and large market movements. Powered by the Tenero API (api.tenero.io). No authentication required.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

chain.description: Chain to query: stacks, spark, or sportsfun (default: stacks)

limit.description: Maximum number of whale trades to return (default: 10, max: 50)

name: tenero_whale_trades
